# Spar 0.7.5

**Spar 0.7.5 gets the coach out of its own way. Fewer fixed rules, more of
its own judgement, and real problems at your level instead of another
near-repeat.**

## A coach that thinks for itself

- **No more near-repeats.** The coach used to be held to a narrow rating
  window and a search that often found nothing, so it fell back to writing
  its own variation of a problem you'd just done. It now sees where every
  problem sits against your rating and picks the next step itself, usually
  a real LeetCode or Codeforces problem with a new idea in it.
- **Practice search finds things.** Searches by topic and by finer-grained
  ideas now map onto LeetCode and Codeforces tags properly, and a search
  that matches nothing falls back to the topic instead of coming back empty.
- **Fewer fixed steps.** The coach no longer runs a checklist after every
  solve or follows scripted instructions from the app. It decides what a
  moment calls for, and replies sooner.
- **Its notes are its own.** It keeps notes on how you learn whenever it
  has something worth remembering, and can write as much as it needs.
- **It sees your whole history.** Every challenge, ability, lesson and
  review on the Track is in front of it when it picks the next step, not
  just the latest few.
- **Help is counted as help.** A pass after the coach helped you during
  the attempt counts as assisted, and the challenge card now says "Coach
  helped".

## Challenges Spar writes

- **Faster to build.** The checks a new challenge goes through now run
  side by side.
- **Fewer failed builds.** A dropped connection is retried once, and a
  provider outage is reported as an outage instead of as a bad problem.
- **Stop means stop.** Pressing Stop while a challenge is being written is
  shown as stopped, not as the provider going silent.
- **Example cards are back** on Spar's own problems, including statements
  that don't use an "Examples" heading.

## Reading the thread

- **Long titles wrap** instead of being cut off with "…", in the challenge
  header, on the problem page and in the coach's steps.
- **Notebook changes show what changed.** A long notebook used to show "No
  changes from the previous version" under an update that did change it.
- **Maths in LeetCode write-ups** reads as text instead of raw dollar
  signs, and unlabelled code blocks are labelled with your language.

## Downloads

| Your machine | File |
| --- | --- |
| Mac, Apple silicon | `Spar-0.7.5-arm64.dmg` |
| Mac, Intel | `Spar-0.7.5.dmg` |
| Windows | `Spar-0.7.5-x64.exe` |
| Linux | `Spar-0.7.5-x86_64.AppImage` or `Spar-0.7.5-amd64.deb` |

## Known limits

- This open distribution is unsigned. macOS Gatekeeper or Windows SmartScreen
  may ask you to approve the first launch of a downloaded installer. Updates
  installed from inside Spar don't ask again.
- Linux AppImage installations can self-update when the runtime supports it;
  `.deb` installations stay managed by the system package manager.
